purpose: Test whether an official Smithsonian locality record could independently resolve the Canmahala Bay locality to a province or region without transferring coordinates or specimen identity.

candidateSource.provider: Smithsonian Institution / National Museum of Natural History
candidateSource.evidenceClass: official indexed search-result excerpts identified potential locality-record targets; excerpts are discovery leads only under the repository source policy

accessAttempts.method: web open of official si.edu object records
accessAttempts.result: Timed out for both target records.

accessAttempts.method: direct PowerShell request to official si.edu object page
direct PowerShell request to official collections.si.edu search results

accessAttempts.result: HTTP 200 for the generic search homepage only; target record details were not retrieved.

decision.reason: The official target records were not successfully retrieved. Search-index excerpts cannot support detailed assertion extraction under the project access-evidence policy. A separate record or locality phrase cannot establish the exact location of the 2025 checklist lots or a maritime administrative boundary.

limitations: No conclusion is made that Canmahala Bay is outside Camarines Sur, Region V, or any other area; the administrative match remains unresolved.
No coordinates from a separate museum specimen or literature locality may be assigned to any 2025 checklist lot.
No bay, stream, municipal-water, or provincial-water geometry was sourced.
The indexed leads do not establish current fish presence, a complete fish inventory, fishing access, legality, safety, diet, or bait suitability.
nextAction: Use a successfully retrievable official NMNH record or a separately licensed gazetteer/map before revisiting the place-name crosswalk. Continue other independently accessible, reusable evidence work in parallel; do not send an access request without separate authorization.
